All 7 routes load (/, /events, /gallery, /services, /about, /contact, /admin/login) with correct data-testid roots. Brand tokens verified live: hero-quote-btn bg = rgb(192,90,23) (#C05A17 amber-700 -> brand dark orange), H1 color = rgb(15,44,89) (#0F2C59 brand navy). Favicon logo loads on Home and Admin login (naturalWidth=512). GalleryStrip on Home renders 6 newest images from GALLERY, all loaded (0 broken), each links to /gallery, plus 'View full gallery' link works. Hero CTAs navigate correctly (hero-quote-btn -> /contact, hero-events-btn -> /events). Gallery page: all 8 category filter testids present, football filter yields 3 items, lightbox opens on gallery-item-0. Contact form submit reaches contact-success. Admin login with admin@sportily.travel / Sportily@2026 reaches /admin and page-admin-dashboard renders. 12/12 home images load; 0 broken images.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> in Contact.jsx line 105 select-event dropdown. This is from dev-tool instrumentation wrapping the option's text expression in a <span>. Not a regression from this iteration and does not break functionality, but option elements only accept text — should be reviewed.

critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx still uses legacy Tailwind class names (amber-700, stone-900, stone-100) that visually resolve to the new brand palette only because tailwind.config.js overrides the amber and stone-900/950 scales. This is intentional and works, but is fragile — future devs may re-add amber utilities not realizing they mean brand orange. Recommend renaming to bg-brand / bg-brand-dark / text-navy over time.
index.css .overline uses @apply text-amber-700 — again works via config override but semantically misleading.

framer-motion prints repeated warning: 'container should have non-static position for scroll offset' from Hero useScroll ref target. Cosmetic but noisy — add `relative` to the section (it is already relative, so likely the parent wrapper). Low priority.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Palette change is stable. Contact.jsx select-event <span>-in-<option> hydration warning is pre-existing dev instrumentation, not a regression. All primary flows (home CTAs, gallery filters, gallery lightbox, contact submit, admin login) confirmed working end-to-end via public URL.
